text: Inferred this slice as a new Current Reservations read model because the earlier Active Reservations read model sits before Cancel Reservation and Edit Reservation on the timeline, and the platform disallows connecting a later-column event back into an earlier read model. This new read model folds in Table Reserved + Reservation Cancelled + Reservation Updated and gets its own new screen (a straight copy of the original Reservations table, no live cancel/edit data available to render statically). Worth deciding: should the original Active Reservations slice/screen be deprecated in favor of this one, or do both stay as distinct views?
author: modeling-agent
